toast.pasteRateMismatch: Cannot paste into a track with a different sample rate ({from} Hz → {to} Hz)
settings.rememberFolder: Remember folders for open and save
settings.rememberFolderHelp: Opens the picker in the last used folder (Chrome and Edge only)
settings.recentFilesHelp: Reopen from the File menu (Chrome and Edge only)
settings.showBeatGrid: Show beat lines on the waveform
settings.showDebugHelp: Shown at the bottom left. Toggle with Ctrl+Shift+D
settings.seekAfterInsert: Move playhead to end after inserting into the waveform
settings.tempoStretch: Stretch all tracks when tempo changes
settings.tempoStretchHelp: When you enter a BPM, all tracks are stretched to that tempo
settings.fastMathHelp: Uses approximations. Turn off for standard math (for comparison)
settings.realtimeAlignHelp: Aligns grain joins for less roughness
settings.showLegacyAlgorithmsHelp: List Legacy Solis, Legacy Pisol and Legacy Wevia in the menu and defaults
settings.showExperimentalAlgorithmsHelp: Show Specraw, still in development, in the method list
settings.filePickerHelp: Choose Classic if Google Drive or other file managers are unavailable on phones
settings.filePickerAuto: Auto (picker on PC, classic on phones)
settings.devUpdatesHelp: Notify about new commits even when the version number is the same
settings.showMaterialButtonHelp: Show "WAV" next to the selection in the status bar. Click to save to folder, drag to a folder to export
settings.showVoiceSplitHelp: Adds items to Tools and the right-click "Vocal extraction" menu that split audio into two voices (higher and lower, or louder and quieter). Only the selection is split if there is one. Works best on simple harmony
settings.parallelProcessHelp: Splits pitch changes of audio 20 seconds or longer into 10-second sections and processes them on multiple CPU cores at once. Seams are joined with matched waveform phase (each section may shift by up to 5 ms). Pitch curve edits and tempo stretching are not included
settings.suspendWhenStoppedHelp: Suspends the AudioContext while stopped. Turn off if iOS plays no sound
settings.playbackSession: Play with iOS silent switch on
settings.playbackSessionHelp: Sets the audio session to playback. Off = previous behavior
settings.vocalMemoryHelp: Lower this if extraction fails on iOS. Applies from the next extraction
settings.extractDiagnoseHelp: Checks on this device why extraction runs out of memory. Select and copy the result to report it
settings.spliceFadeHelp: At edit and paste boundaries. Too short may click on low sounds
settings.autoTempo: Analyze tempo when opening a file
settings.autoTempoHelp: Sets the BPM and first beat automatically. If the result is doubled or halved, correct it from the BPM display below
settings.flattenStrengthHelp: 100% removes the wobble. Lower keeps more of the original
settings.vocalFreshHelp: Saves your work and reopens the app before extracting, so extraction runs with more free memory. Use this if the app closes after extracting on iPad and similar devices. Undo history is cleared
settings.vocalModelReplaced: {from} is not compatible with the GPU, so {name} is used for extraction
settings.vocalGpuUnsupported: This model does not support the GPU, so it is processed on the CPU. For faster processing, choose another model
settings.vocalGpuHelp: Faster. Falls back to CPU when unavailable or with the light model. Turn this off if the result looks wrong
settings.vocalSlowCpu: Without the GPU, this takes about 10 times the song length
settings.stemModelHelp: Takes several times the song length (about 6 times without the GPU)
settings.stemChorus: Split vocals into lead and harmony
settings.stemChorusHelp: Also uses the lead vocal model
settings.vocalKeepHighBandHelp: Also keeps above about 11 kHz. The voice sounds brighter, but high sounds such as cymbals are more likely to leak in
settings.keepOriginalHelp: Keeps the audio before processing, for comparing with Original and creating tracks from it. When off, each applied edit becomes the new original, which saves memory and project size
settings.showMetersHelp: Shows the playback level for the whole mix (toolbar on PC, bottom play bar on mobile) and for each track (track panel)
settings.minimapPlayheadHelp: Shows the playhead line on the minimap
settings.projectEmpty: Open a file to set the project name and tempo
settings.title: Settings
settings.autoRestore: Autosave work and restore it next time
settings.autoRestoreHelp: Audio is stored only in this browser and never uploaded
settings.confirmCloseHelp: When autosave is off and running as an app, asks if there are unsaved changes
settings.saveMemoryHelp: Moves the original audio of edited tracks to device storage and loads it only when needed
settings.uiScaleHelp: Scales text, inputs, buttons, and everything else together
settings.mobileUiHelp: Controls and layout on phones. The new layout shows edit buttons below when a range is selected
settings.recordHelp: Processing the browser applies while recording. If you will edit the recorded voice, turn all of these off. Choose the input in the recording window
settings.outputDeviceHelp: Device used for playback and previews
settings.showKanaVoice: Create kana sounds from a voice (experimental)
settings.showKanaVoiceHelp: Shows "Create vowels from a vowel" in Tools. Creates the other vowels from the vowel in the selection (or the whole track), keeping the voice quality and changing only the resonances
settings.kanaStrengthHelp: Lower values keep more of the original voice quality at the cost of vowel clarity
settings.addonFolder: Store add-ons in a chosen folder
settings.addonFolderHelp: Saves add-ons such as models to a folder you choose instead of the browser's storage (Chrome, Edge). Applies to add-ons installed from now on; installed ones keep working
settings.tempoChangeHelp: Checks whether the tempo changes partway through during automatic analysis. If a change is detected, you will be asked whether to use it
export.title: Export audio

preset.label: Presets
algorithm.psolaHint: Splices at pitch periods. For voice
algorithm.sola2Hint: For voice. Stays clean on long stretches
algorithm.sola3Hint: Improved Solis. Smooth voice with less breath and roughness
algorithm.wsolaHint: Overlaps similar waveforms. Fast, good for consonants
algorithm.psola2Hint: Splices at pitch periods. Less roughness
algorithm.wsola2Hint: Fast, good for consonants. Less smearing
algorithm.hpssHint: Stretches drums and tones separately. For songs with drums
algorithm.pv2Hint: For chords and percussion. Sharper attacks
algorithm.pvHint: For chords and percussion. Smooth stretching
algorithm.smsHint: Experimental. Degrades less on round trips and repeated edits. Works on chords and backing too
pitchTool.up: Raise pitch a semitone (↑, Shift+↑ for 0.1)
pitchTool.down: Lower pitch a semitone (↓, Shift+↓ for 0.1)
pitchTool.hint: The curve appears as a blue line in the pitch lane. Press Apply in the toolbar to render it
snap.title: Snap to scale
snap.nearest: Snap each note to the nearest semitone
vibrato.title: Vibrato
volume.title: Volume
volume.normalizeTooltip: Set the loudest peak to -1 dB
wave.aria: Waveform (drag to select, Ctrl+drag to add a range, drag a range edge to adjust, Shift+drag the right edge to stretch, click to move the playhead)
wave.drawPitchTooltip: Draw pitch (Shift: snap to semitones / Alt: erase)
wave.grabPitchTooltip: Grab and move pitch (Shift: semitone steps)
wave.drawGainTooltip: Draw a volume curve (Shift: snap to 1 dB / Alt: restore original)
wave.drawFormantTooltip: Draw a formant curve (Shift: snap to semitone / Alt: restore original)
shortcuts.noSnap: Hold while dragging to disable snapping to beat lines
shortcuts.adjust: Adjust the range (Shift+right edge to stretch)
tempo.tapHint: Tap on the beat a few times to set the BPM from the interval
update.unsupported: Cannot check for updates in this environment
update.failed: Update check failed (check your network connection)

data.workHelp: Autosaved audio and work state. Open work is saved again on the next edit
data.cacheHelp: The app saved for offline use. It is downloaded again next time
data.cacheConfirm: Delete the offline cache? A network connection is needed next time.
data.cacheDone: Cache deleted. It will be downloaded again next time
data.addonsHelp: Downloaded vocal extraction models and runtime ({size}). They will need to be downloaded again next time
data.addonsConfirm: Delete all downloaded add-ons (vocal extraction models and runtime)?
data.settingsHelp: Settings, panel widths, etc. Resetting reloads the page
data.settingsConfirm: Reset settings and layout, and reload?
data.allHelp: Deletes all of the above and reloads
data.allConfirm: Delete work data, cache, settings and add-ons, and reload? This cannot be undone.
data.persistHelp: Ask the browser not to delete autosaved data when storage is low
data.persistOn: Granted (the browser will not delete it automatically)
data.persistDenied: Denied by the browser (more likely granted for frequently used or installed apps)

addon.uvrKara2: Vocal extraction lead vocal model (splits lead and harmony, UVR Karaoke 2)
extract.outOfMemory: Not enough memory to extract. Reload the page and try again, or choose the Light model in Settings > Vocal extraction. For long songs, extract in parts or use WeVocalExtractor
extract.gpuLost: The connection to the GPU was lost ({reason}). Fully close and reopen the browser; the GPU may be unavailable until then
extract.noAdapter: WebGPU is not available (the browser may have blocked WebGPU for this site; fully restarting the browser may fix it)
extract.gpuFallback: Could not process on the GPU ({reason}). Continue on the CPU? This takes longer (about 10 times the song length with high-quality models)
extract.cleanConfirm: Not enough memory to extract. Save your work, reload the page and extract with nothing else running? (Undo history will be lost)
extract.cleanHint: Extracting before loading the rest of the app to free up memory
extract.crashedConfirm: The app closed during or right after the last vocal extraction, possibly because memory ran out. Turn on "Free memory before extracting"? (You can change this under Vocal extraction in Settings)

kanaCut.readingsHelp: Enter readings in hiragana. The range of each sound is found from these readings
